description: This Java source file defines the DefaultAkkaReplicatorConfig class, which provides a default implementation for configuring Akka's Replicator component within an Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for constructing configuration instances from provided Config objects or specific parameters, and overrides standard methods such as equals, hashCode, and toString.

classes.name: DefaultAkkaReplicatorConfig
classes.description: Implements AkkaReplicatorConfig with configurations loaded from Typesafe Config, providing methods to create instances with default or specific parameters.

methods.description: Creates a DefaultAkkaReplicatorConfig instance from a given Config object, using fallback configurations for completeness.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultAkkaReplicatorConfig with explicitly specified name and role, along with a Config object.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the replicator.

methods.name: getRole
methods.description: Returns the role of the cluster members with replicas.

methods.name: getCompleteConfig
methods.description: Returns the complete Config object used for this replicator configuration.
